title: Cook
description:
This is a part time position in our Dietary Department as a Cook.

  • The rate of pay is $19.50 per hour.

 

Please walk-in to our facility any day, Monday through Friday between the hours of 12 PM and 2:30PM. We are located at 181 Clifton St., New Haven, CT 06513.

Looking forward to meeting you! Ask for Human Resources

 

Duties Include:

  • preparation, cooking, and service of all planned meals
  • managing meal / tray line service 
  • general cleaning kitchen schedules
  • compliance with resident Diet Orders
  • open communication with RDs

Requirements:

  • Certification in healthcare cooking (ServSafe)
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in large-scale cooking (preferred)
  • Strong knowledge of large scale & therapeutic food prep
  • Must be able to do some physical work
  • Strong leadership skills and a team player
  • High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • Excellent customer service & communication skills

title: CNA EVERY OTHER WEEKEND | Union 1199 Position
description:
New Haven Center for Nursing and Rehabilitation, part of Essential Care, is located in a beautiful North End of New Haven minutes from I91 and I95, on the North Haven and North Branford town line. We are also in the process of building a state of art facility with 150 private rooms to replace our current location. The new building should be complete in approximately 2 years. Come join the team as we transition into the new facility and be part of something special. 

We are looking for a dynamic CNA to work with our newly hired DNS, ADNS, and experienced nursing team. The right candidate will ensure top quality resident care and customer service. The right candidate must be a great communicator and communicate with staff and management alike.

 

We just completed our Annual Survey and had minimal deficiencies and no significant findings. We are also back in compliance.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Assist with daily living activities. This includes delivering meals to patients, turning and ambulating patients and providing plenty of fresh water, as well as extra nourishment between meals
  • Help patients with personal hygiene. Provide patients with bedpans, help with baths, shampoos and showers
  • Provide adjunct care for the patient, including ice packs, non-sterile dressings and therapeutic baths
  • Check vital signs and record daily information in the patient’s chart
  • Assist the nurses and other staff as needed
  • Adhere to professional standards, follow policies and procedures and abide by federal, state and local requirements, as well as Joint Commission standards

 

Up to date CNA certificate required for consideration.

  • 181 Clifton St, New Haven, CT 06513

PTA Duties Include:

  • · Provides skilled physical therapy services/interventions following physician orders under the supervision of a Registered Physical Therapist.
